# source for

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sourceFor`](gmeow-sourceFor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceFor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Relates a creative work (a [`BookRelease`](../classes/gmeow-BookRelease.md), [`SerialInstallment`](../classes/gmeow-SerialInstallment.md), film, game, or other out-of-universe artifact) to the narrative reference frame it contributes to, witnesses, revises, or serves as a source for. Non-functional: a work may source several frames, and a frame may have many sources. The specific role (source, witness, revision, adaptation) is carried by [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the claim or by a reified relator when needed.
